description: Skill catalog for the specweave plugin. The plugin version is tracked in .claude-plugin/plugin.json (stamped from package.json); this file only lists what ships.

skills.name: sw:increment
skills.description: Plan a unit of work: spec.md with Problem, Scope, numbered ACs and an Approach, plus tasks.md definitions.

skills.name: sw:do
skills.description: Work the increment task by task through the ledger: task next, claim, implement, commit, task done with evidence.

skills.name: sw:done
skills.description: Close an increment: ledger check, specweave verify, optional review, specweave complete.

skills.name: sw:review
skills.description: Adversarial fresh-context review; every finding cites path:line and is re-verified. Replaces grill, code-reviewer and judge-llm.

skills.name: sw:team
skills.description: Several agents on one increment: a worktree each, claims through the ledger, one closure. Replaces team-lead and team-merge.

skills.name: sw:handoff
skills.description: Portable, secret-scrubbed handoff doc so the work continues in any AI tool or on any machine.

skills.name: sw:sync
skills.description: One sync surface for GitHub, Jira and Azure DevOps: push, pull, status, setup. Replaces the per-provider sync, mapper, validator and import skills.

skills.name: sw:auto
skills.description: Unattended execution driven by the Stop hook until every task is done.

skills.name: sw:brainstorm
skills.description: Expand the option space before committing to one, ending in a pick handed to sw:increment.

skills.name: sw:qa
skills.description: Risk-scored quality assessment via specweave qa: verdict, blockers, optional export to tasks.md.

optionalSkills.note: Not shipped in the plugin. Install with: npx vskill install anton-abyzov/specweave/skills-optional/<name>

removedIn2_0.note: Removed in 2.0. Use the replacement; there is no alias routing.
